name: NameTag 3
description: We introduce NameTag 3, an open-source tool and cloud-based web service for multilingual, multidataset, and multitagset named entity recognition (NER), supporting both flat and nested entities. NameTag 3 achieves state-of-the-art results on 21 test datasets in 15 languages and remains competitive on the rest, even against larger models. It is available as a command-line tool and as a cloud-based service, enabling use without local installation.
